definitions.explanation: The act of getting out of bed after sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧6⟦{時|じ}→時：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{起床|きしょう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I wake up at 6 o'clock every day.

examples.japanese: {起床|きしょう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{早|はや}めたら→早める：04587_hayameru⟧、⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When I moved my wake-up time earlier, mornings became easier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{軍隊|ぐんたい}→軍隊：02678_guntai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{起床|きしょう}⟦ラッパ→ラッパ：noentry⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|さ}ます→覚ます：02057_samasu⟧。
examples.english: In the military, people wake up to the reveille bugle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{起床|きしょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧6⟦{時|じ}→時：noentry⟧、⟦{就寝|しゅうしん}→就寝：noentry⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧10⟦{時|じ}→時：noentry⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{決|き}まっている→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: According to the school rules, wake-up is set at 6:00 and bedtime at 10:00.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{起床|きしょう}⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧5⟦{時|じ}→時：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|す}いている→すく：00756_suku⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Since I started working, my wake-up time has become earlier. Getting up at 5 AM is hard, but the trains are empty so commuting is easy.

notes:
{起床|きしょう} is a more formal word for getting up, often used in writing or official contexts.

Common collocations:
- {起床|きしょう}{時間|じかん} (wake-up time)
- {起床|きしょう}する (to get up, to rise)
- {早|はや}{起|お}き (early rising - more casual)

Opposite:
- {就寝|しゅうしん} (going to bed)

Related expressions:
- {起|お}きる (to wake up, to get up - everyday term)
- {目|め}を{覚|さ}ます (to wake up)
- {朝|あさ}{寝坊|ねぼう} (oversleeping)

Usage note:
{起床|きしょう} is more formal than {起|お}きる. It's commonly used in schedules, rules, or formal descriptions of daily routines.
